text: Over the last 30 days, some visitors expressed concerns about overcrowding, especially during school group visits, which limited access to exhibits. Several reviews criticized the heavy reliance on AI-driven interactive elements, feeling these detracted from the educational content and did not adequately convey Theodore Roosevelt’s historical significance. A few visitors noted a lack of depth in the interpretive materials and expected more traditional historical context and analysis. Positive comments frequently mentioned the architecture and interactive exhibits, but there were also remarks about accessibility issues with some kiosks. Staff and food services received occasional mentions, though these were less prominent.

However, some concerns were raised about the use of AI in the exhibits and the historical balance of the content. The interactive exhibits received the most comments, with many visitors engaging deeply and spending significant time in the library. A few reviews mentioned the architecture and landscape, as well as staff and food services, but these were less frequent. Accessibility and timed entry were noted only once each, suggesting these areas may need further attention or clearer communication.

windows.90: Over the past 90 days, some visitors have raised concerns about crowding, especially during school group visits, which limited access to exhibits. Several critical reviews focused on the heavy use of AI in the exhibits, describing it as excessive and detracting from the educational value, with some visitors feeling the content lacked depth about Theodore Roosevelt’s accomplishments. There were also comments about the design of interactive kiosks not accommodating taller guests. While many appreciated the architecture and interactive elements, issues with timed entry and parking were mentioned frequently enough to warrant attention. Overall, the average rating remains high, but these areas suggest opportunities for improvement.
